annotations.title: An employer's insured benefits from Schedule A: carriers, benefit types, covered lives, renewal dates, premiums, and the brokers paid

description:
An employer's insured benefits, from Schedule A of its Form 5500: for each plan, every insured contract
with the carrier (brand and parent group, NAIC code), the benefit types (health, dental, vision, life,
disability, stop loss, HMO/PPO...), persons covered, the policy year and renewal month, premiums (and, for
experience-rated contracts, claims), commissions and fees, and each agent or broker the insurer paid, by name.
Also the plan's benefits as listed on the main form, how they're funded (line 9), totals, and what changed
from the prior year (carriers added or dropped, a new top broker).

Without `pn`: every plan of the EIN that is a health and welfare plan or filed a Schedule A (a retirement
plan's annuity or guaranteed contracts are on Schedule A too). Find the EIN with `search_plans` (kind=welfare for
an employer with no retirement plan here). A plan year with no insured contracts still answers, with
`contracts` empty, and isn't charged. Self-funded benefits, stop-loss the employer buys itself, and broker fees
the employer pays directly aren't on Schedule A: see `meta.coverage_notes`.

Price: $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base (mainnet) with x402 (MCP transport), or from card credits (an app signed in at /connect, or an 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' header). Without payment the tool returns the payment requirements. Errors and empty results aren't charged.

Same data as GET /insurance of the Plan Data API.

ein.description: Sponsor EIN (9 digits, dashes allowed). Without `pn`: every plan under it with insured contracts or a welfare filing.
ein.title: Ein

plan_year.description: Plan year to show. Default: each plan's latest year with a filing.
plan_year.title: Plan Year

pn.description: Plan number (1-999). Health and welfare plans number from 501; a retirement plan's annuity contracts are on Schedule A too.
pn.title: Pn
